meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释每条 senpi 提示，让界面功能一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果使用 senpi 时常想弄懂界面上的每句提示
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth to see what each feature does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often wonder what each tip in senpi means

howto.what: 装上后：用户问起 Senpi 的某条 Tip 时，Claude 会先查询实时提示列表，再读代码核实真实机制，并结合用户设置判断哪些提示对这位用户可见，最后用用户的语言给出带代码路径的原理说明。
howto.when: 当用户询问某条 Tip 的含义、某个被提示功能的作用，或自己能看到哪些 Tip 时，该技能就会接管并解释。

say.text: 刚才界面上的那条“Tip:”是什么意思？结合代码讲讲原理。
say.note: Claude 会核实代码，给出带文件路径的解释。

say.text: 关于“Fable 5 拒绝”后出现的那条 Tip，它背后怎么运作？
say.note: 它会拆解检测、门控、隐藏指令与提示的完整流程。

say.text: Senpi 里我能看到哪些提示？为什么有些没显示？
say.note: 它会读设置与提示历史，说明哪些可见及原因。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about a Senpi tip, Claude queries the live tip list, reads the code to verify the real mechanism, checks the user's settings to see which tips are visible, then explains in the user's language with file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks what a Tip means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: What does that Tip line in the interface mean? Explain the mechanism with code.
say_en.note: Claude will verify and explain with file paths.

say_en.text: How does the tip about Fable 5 refusals actually work?
say_en.note: Explains detection, gating, directive, and visible tip.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see in Senpi, and why are not all of them shown?
say_en.note: Checks settings, history, and gating, then explains.
